Farmer-First Transition No farmer left behind in BPS to ELM transition. Adequate transition support. Simplified scheme design. Digital and non-digital access. 2. Environmental Outcome Payments Payments linked to verified environmental outcomes. Not area-based. Measurable. Auditable. Preventing greenwashing. 3. Food Security Balance Environmental goals balanced with food production. No blanket land-use mandates. Productive agriculture maintained where sustainable. 4. Digital-First with Inclusion Digital scheme management as default. But paper and phone access maintained. No digital exclusion of rural communities. 5. Data Sovereignty Farm data remains farmer-owned. No compulsory data sharing. Privacy-preserving analytics. Transparent data governance. 6.
